title: Enhancing color and comfort: A preliminary clinical study on the Dahl approach using 3D printed noninvasive restorations
html: Clinical evidence regarding the long-term (up to 24 months) color stability of 3-dimensional printed (3D), noninvasive restorations is scarce, particularly when used to implement the Dahl concept. Whether these restorations meet esthetic requirements over time and how potential discoloration affects patient-reported outcomes remains unclear.
